headlines.title: She Started an Allergy-Friendly Snack Brand So Her Daughter Wouldn’t Feel Left Out. Now, the Girl Scouts Are Selling Her Cookies
headlines.description: Denise Woodard started allergy-friendly cookie company, Partake, so her daughter wouldn’t feel left out. Now, she’s selling her cookies with the Girl Scouts.

headlines.title: 7 Satisfying, High-Protein Breakfast Ideas for People Who Don’t Like Eggs, Recommended by Dietitians
headlines.description: Want more protein at breakfast but can’t stand eggs? Dietitians share 7 healthy, high-protein meals to eat in the morning instead.

headlines.title: Ashley Park on Blood Donation Initiative, Wrapping 'Emily in Paris'
headlines.description: Actor Ashley Park joins TODAY’s Sheinelle Jones and guest co-host Justin Sylvester to talk about wrapping the final season of the Netflix hit series “Emily in Paris,” her close friendship with Lily Collins, attending Céline Dion’s comeback performance in Paris, and how her childhood battle with leukemia led her to work with Abbott to address the national blood shortage.

headlines.title: MLB's CC Sabathia Shares Health Message, Talks Hall of Fame
headlines.description: MLB star CC Sabathia joins TODAY to share a message about the importance of understanding your cholesterol numbers and shares his own health scare. “I was pitching in the big leagues and had no idea I had this blockage and just got lucky enough to be able to catch it,” he says. He also opens up about being inducted into the Monument Park Hall of Fame at Yankee Stadium. “It means more than going into the Hall of Fame…To be able to come to the Bronx, put on the pinstripes and succeed here�

headlines.title: Tracking Macros for Beginners: A Step-by-Step Guide
headlines.description: Tracking your macros means going beyond calorie count and tracking your protein, carbohydrates, and fat. NBC News medical contributor Natalie Azar and TODAY nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer break down the process for tracking macros, discuss who should be doing it, list the recommended ratio for carbs, fat and protein, and the benefits of logging the information.

headlines.title: Why Women Are Struggling to Fill Estrogen Patch Prescriptions
headlines.description: Demand for hormone replacement therapy has soared after a study found the link between HRT and the risk of breast cancer to be much smaller than previously reported and after the FDA removed the black box warning in November 2025. That’s when women reported facing problems filling their prescriptions. NBC’s Yasmin Vossoughian, host of the "Here's the Scoop" podcast, reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: What’s in Target’s NCAA collection
headlines.description: Target’s NCAA collection includes licensed apparel and accessories for more than 50 schools. Here are 11 items that show the range of the assortment.

headlines.title: This Lego bouquet set doubles as a fun activity and home decor — and it’s almost $50 off
headlines.description: The Lego Botanicals Flower arrangement is currently 44% off – its lowest price this year. With over 1,000 pieces and 14 types of flowers, it’s a fun activity and home decor.

headlines.title: Early October Prime Day deals just dropped — I hand-picked 33+ actually worth shopping
headlines.description: Prime Big Deal Days starts on October 6, but early deals are already live. Shop expert-approved picks at least 20% off from Lego, Medicube, Casper and more.

headlines.title: How to pack winter emergency kit for your car
headlines.description: Learn what to put in your winter car kit, plus shop pre-made kits and supplies like jump starters, flashlights, tire chains and more.

headlines.title: Ashley Park Says Receiving Blood Transfusions Amid Her Cancer Diagnosis at 15 Felt Like ‘Someone’s There With Me’
headlines.description: Ashley Park of “Emily in Paris” is promoting a blood drive and reflected on her own experience receiving blood transfusions after being diagnosed with cancer at 15.

headlines.title: Burgers Have Meat and Vegetables. Why Aren’t They Considered Healthy? A Dietitian Explains
headlines.description: The burger is meat and veggies, shouldn’t it be considered healthy? A dietitian explains why this protein-dense and vitamin-loaded meal is still an indulgence. Plus, how to tweak it.
